comment: Scope is the two published packages plus their tests. Each examples/<project>
is a standalone npm project with its own tsconfig.json and its own
node_modules — including them here loaded ~15 duplicate copies of the NestJS
and MCP SDK type trees into one program, which exhausted the default heap.
An example is typechecked from inside its own directory; note that under
'npm run examples:local' that needs --preserveSymlinks, or resolution follows
the @rekog/* symlink out to the root node_modules and loads a second copy.
'packages/*/src' rather than 'packages/**' so built output in packages/*/dist
is not compiled alongside the sources it was generated from.
